title: Al-Fattah: The Divine Name That Means Judge, Not Opener
excerpt: Al-Fattah occurs once in the Quran. It is widely rendered "the Opener" — but in the one verse where it appears, al-Jalalayn glosses it with a single word: al-hakim, the Judge.
seo_title: Al-Fattah: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Fattah appears once in the Quran, at 34:26. Al-Jalalayn glosses it "the Judge", not "the Opener". What the name means and why the difference matters.
